directions: Suppose your university is selecting some students to teach kids in remote rural areas during the coming vacation. You are now to write an application letter to the university to explain why you want to take
sample_essay:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to apply for the opportunity to teach kids in remote rural areas during the coming vacation. To begin with, I have a strong passion for education. I believe every child deserves a good education, regardless of where they live. For instance, I once volunteered at a local primary school and saw how a little bit of teaching could make a big difference in the kids' lives.

In addition, I have relevant teaching skills. I have taken several education-related courses in university, which have equipped me with the knowledge of how to design interesting lessons and interact with students effectively.

Furthermore, I am physically and mentally prepared for this task. I understand that teaching in rural areas may face many challenges, such as poor living conditions, but I am willing to overcome them.

In conclusion, I am confident that I am the right person for this job. I sincerely hope you can give me this precious opportunity.

Yours faithfully,
[Your Name]
